blocks.en: As the remarks of the last section on ODEs indicated, the choice of boundary conditions is of paramount importance in determining the well-posedness of a given problem. The following two common types of boundary conditions on a bounded domain $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ yield well-posed problems and will be studied in a more general context in later chapters.
blocks.zh: 正如上一节关于常微分方程的讨论所指出的, 边界条件的选择对确定一个给定问题的适定性极为重要. 有界区域 $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ 上下面两种常见的边界条件会给出适定问题, 后面各章将在更一般的背景下研究它们.

blocks.zh: 用分离变量法求解

blocks.en: The first method we present for solving Laplace's equation is the most widely used technique for solving partial differential equations: separation of variables. The technique involves reducing a partial differential equation to a system of ordinary differential equations and expressing the solution of the PDE as a sum or infinite series.
blocks.zh: 首先介绍的 Laplace 方程求解方法, 是求解偏微分方程时使用最广泛的技巧: 分离变量法. 这一技巧将偏微分方程化为一组常微分方程, 并将偏微分方程的解表示成有限和或无穷级数.

blocks.en: The removal of the quotation marks from the sentence above was one of the more important mathematical projects of the nineteenth century. Specifically, mathematicians needed to specify the type of convergence implied by the representation \eqref{eq:fourier-sine-series} and then identify the class of functions that can be achieved by that type of convergence. In later chapters we describe some of the main results in this area, but for the moment let us just accept Fourier's assertion and try to deduce its consequences.
blocks.zh: 去掉上面那句话中的引号, 是十九世纪较为重要的数学课题之一. 具体来说, 数学家需要明确表示式 \eqref{eq:fourier-sine-series} 所蕴含的收敛类型, 再确定通过这种收敛能够得到哪一类函数. 后面各章将介绍这方面的一些主要结果, 但现在先接受 Fourier 的断言, 并尝试推导其结果.

blocks.en:
It remains to answer the following questions:
\begin{itemize}
\item Does the series \eqref{eq:infinite-sine-square-solution} converge and if so in what sense?
\item Is the limit of the series differentiable, and if so, does it satisfy \eqref{eq:laplace-planar}? That is, can we take the derivatives under the summation sign?
\item In what sense are the boundary conditions met?
\item Is the separation of variables solution the only solution of the problem? More generally, is the problem well-posed?
\end{itemize}
All of these questions will be answered in a more general context in later chapters.
blocks.zh:
还有以下问题有待回答:
\begin{itemize}
\item 级数 \eqref{eq:infinite-sine-square-solution} 是否收敛? 若收敛, 是在什么意义下收敛?
\item 级数的极限是否可微? 若可微, 是否满足 \eqref{eq:laplace-planar}? 即能否在求和号下求导?
\item 边界条件是在什么意义下满足的?
\item 分离变量法得到的解是否是该问题的唯一解? 更一般地, 问题是否适定?
\end{itemize}
后面各章将在更一般的背景下回答所有这些问题.

blocks.en: Poisson's integral formula in the upper half-plane
blocks.zh: 上半平面中的 Poisson 积分公式

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In this section we describe \emph{Poisson's integral formula in the upper half-plane}. This formula gives the solution of Dirichlet's problem in the upper half-plane. It is often derived in elementary complex variables courses.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍\emph{上半平面中的 Poisson 积分公式}. 该公式给出上半平面中 Dirichlet 问题的解. 初等复变函数课程经常推导这一公式.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Poisson's integral formula is an example of the use of \emph{integral operators} to solve boundary-value problems. In later chapters we will generalize the technique through the use of \emph{Green's functions}.
blocks.zh: Poisson 积分公式是利用\emph{积分算子}求解边值问题的一个例子. 后面各章将通过使用 \emph{Green 函数}来推广这一技巧.

blocks.en: Variational formulations
blocks.zh: 变分表述

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In this section we give a demonstration of a \emph{variational} technique for proving the existence of solutions of Dirichlet's problem on a "general" domain $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$. The technique should probably not be considered elementary (since as we shall see in later chapters its rigorous application requires some rather heavy machinery), but it is presented in many elementary courses (particularly in Physics and Engineering) using the formal arguments we sketch here.
blocks.zh: 本节演示一种\emph{变分}技巧, 用来证明"一般"区域 $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ 上 Dirichlet 问题解的存在性. 这一技巧或许不应算作初等方法 (因为后面各章将会看到, 严格应用它需要相当有力的工具), 但许多初等课程 (尤其是物理学和工程学课程) 都会采用这里概述的形式论证来介绍它.

blocks.en: The result that allows us to use \eqref{eq:laplace-weak-form} to deduce that $\bar u$ satisfies Laplace's equation is a version of the \emph{fundamental lemma of the calculus of variations}. (This name has been given to a wide range of results that allow one to deduce that a function that satisfies a variational equation such as \eqref{eq:laplace-weak-form} also satisfies a pointwise differential equation. Another name commonly used in the same way is the DuBois-Reymond lemma in honor of the first versions of such a result.) We now prove a very weak version of this result.
blocks.zh: 使我们能够利用 \eqref{eq:laplace-weak-form} 推出 $\bar u$ 满足 Laplace 方程的结果, 是\emph{变分法基本引理}的一种版本. (这一名称被用于一大类结果: 从某个函数满足像 \eqref{eq:laplace-weak-form} 这样的变分方程, 推出它也逐点满足某个微分方程. 另一个常被用于同一意义的名称是 DuBois-Reymond 引理, 以纪念此类结果的最早版本.) 下面证明这一结果的一个很弱的版本.

blocks.en: Equation \eqref{eq:laplace-weak-form} is known as the \emph{weak form} of Laplace's equation. We refer to a solution of \eqref{eq:laplace-general} as a \emph{strong solution} and a solution of \eqref{eq:laplace-weak-form} as a \emph{weak solution} of Laplace's equation. We will generalize these notions to many other types of equations in later chapters.
blocks.zh: 方程 \eqref{eq:laplace-weak-form} 称为 Laplace 方程的\emph{弱形式}. 我们将 \eqref{eq:laplace-general} 的解称为 Laplace 方程的\emph{强解}, 将 \eqref{eq:laplace-weak-form} 的解称为其\emph{弱解}. 后面各章将把这些概念推广到许多其他类型的方程.

blocks.en: However, as we noted above when we showed that a solution of the minimum energy problem was a weak solution of Laplace's equation, unless we know more about the continuity of a weak solution we cannot show it is a strong solution. This is a common theme in the modern theory of PDEs. It is often easy to find some sort of weak solution to an equation, but relatively hard to show that the weak solution is in fact a strong solution.
blocks.zh: 然而, 正如上面说明极小能量问题的解是 Laplace 方程的弱解时所指出的, 如果对弱解的连续性没有更多了解, 就无法证明它是强解. 这是现代偏微分方程理论中的一个常见主题. 找到方程的某种弱解往往容易, 而证明该弱解实际上是强解则相对困难.

blocks.en:
Compute the Fourier sine series coefficients for the following functions defined on the interval $[0,1]$.\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
\item $f(x)=x^2-x$.
\item $f(x)=\cos\dfrac{\pi x}{4}$.
\item $f(x)=\begin{cases}3x,&x\in[0,1/4)\\1-x,&x\in[1/4,1].\end{cases}$
\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh:
计算下列定义在区间 $[0,1]$ 上的函数的 Fourier 正弦级数系数.\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
\item $f(x)=x^2-x$.
\item $f(x)=\cos\dfrac{\pi x}{4}$.
\item $f(x)=\begin{cases}3x,&x\in[0,1/4)\\1-x,&x\in[1/4,1].\end{cases}$
\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: ex:sine-coefficients-three-functions

blocks.en:
Verify that the Laplacian takes the following form in polar coordinates in $\mathbb{R}^2$:
\[
\Delta u:=\dfrac1r\dfrac{\partial}{\partial r}\left(r\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial r}\right)+\dfrac1{r^2}\dfrac{\partial^2u}{\partial\theta^2}.
\]
blocks.zh:
验证, Laplace 算子在 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 的极坐标下具有如下形式:
\[
\Delta u:=\dfrac1r\dfrac{\partial}{\partial r}\left(r\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial r}\right)+\dfrac1{r^2}\dfrac{\partial^2u}{\partial\theta^2}.
\]
blocks.label: ex:laplacian-polar-coordinates

blocks.en:
Use the divergence theorem to derive Green's identity
\[
\int_\Omega(\Delta u)v\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}=-\int_\Omega\nabla u\cdot\nabla v\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}+\int_{\partial\Omega}v\nabla u\cdot\bm{n}\,\mathrm{d}S.
\]
blocks.zh:
利用散度定理推导 Green 恒等式
\[
\int_\Omega(\Delta u)v\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}=-\int_\Omega\nabla u\cdot\nabla v\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}+\int_{\partial\Omega}v\nabla u\cdot\bm{n}\,\mathrm{d}S.
\]
